integrity: Standalone standard-library Python verifier generates the finite complex from its graph definition and checks the full Morse matching, acyclicity, signed characters and integer multiplicities.
scientific_limitations: Single ten-vertex graph and ordinary four-cut parameter only.
The rational group-character calculation does not determine an integral equivariant lattice.
No canonical equivariant sphere decomposition and no infinite-family theorem are asserted.
The homotopy certificate is an exact finite acyclic face-matching computation; independent audit has not been performed.
title: The Petersen four-cut complex: 26 five-spheres and its full symmetric-group character
